main_text.p: sed de superioritate, quam dicūt; & probavimus antea, jus convocandi concilii fuisse penes Imperatorem in ecclesiâ veteri, atque etiam Papam Romanū tum supplicasse imperatoribus: nunc autem omnibus imperat: 22 Concilium sine auctoritate Romani pontificis congregatum esse indignum concilii nomine: nam non esse in nomine Christi congregatum.

Resp. Respondeo cum Cusano Cardin. libro 2. de concil. cathol. cap. 25. & aliis doctoribus pontificiis. Ergo octo prima concilia non fuerunt firma, quoniam per Imperatores congregata leguntur, & Romanus pontifex ad instar aliorū patriarcharum sacras jussiones pro veniendo aut mittendo ad concilia recepit. Deinde non æquipollent hæc duo: In nomine Christi, & in nomine vel auctoritate Papæ congregare concilium. Rectius igitur Arias Montanus in locum Matth. 18.20. in nomine Christi dicit significare in spiritum Christi. & Jansenius in concord. c.72. In nomine, inquit, id est

page.notes: Right page: the facing page is cut off by the right edge and set in very narrow columns; its lines are not legible enough to transcribe and are left out. Faint show-through at the bottom left (a word like "hoc") is not transcribed. The "22" before the italic passage is a small printed number, placed as a note. The page number is printed in small capitals as "IIO".
